newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK -LEADING SHARES START TO CLIMB.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK -LEADING SHARES START TO CLIMB.

text.p: with a rush of dealing as several leading Namibian shares
At least one broker expects good news from Namibia Breweries
and the price has edged up from Monday's opening of N$2.70 to
N$2.80 in heavy buying throughout the week.
CIC Holdings has also climbed. After opening the week at
N$2.71 it closed at N$2.90. Namibian Sea Produvts had a
roller-coaster week as it recovered from recent falls, and rose
from 75 cents to N$1.00 before edging lower again in dealing on
the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Friday to end at 92 cents.
A total of over N$19.4 million worth of shares was traded
during the last week with a volume of 1,246,240 shares bought
The NSE overall index did not gain much overall, ending the
week at 234.67, compared to 234.60 the previous Friday.
